title: The optimal ordinal MMS guarantee for goods
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: For each n, determine the least integer d(n) such that every instance of nonnegative additive goods among n agents admits a complete allocation giving each agent at least her 1-out-of-d(n) maximin share.
context:
The share is evaluated by dividing all goods into d(n) bundles and maximizing the minimum value. This is not an ordinal-preference-only input model.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: An alternative to multiplicative relaxation that keeps an agent's partition-based fairness standard intact.
